Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Hi Sofia / Ben —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap + the follow-ups we agreed on so we’re aligned on sizing and the pricing options to present: 

Call recap / assumptions
- Target go-live: July 2026 (pilot in June)
- Expected monthly inference volume: rough ballpark from your side (please confirm below)
- Workload: ~95% short-context (<=512 tokens), ~5% long-context (2–4k tokens)
- Latency SLO target: P95 <= 250ms for interactive endpoints
- Availability: 99.9% preferred

Key open items for sizing/pricing
1) Monthly token volume (prompt + generation) — please confirm an expected range (min/typical/peak).
2) Throughput targets (average qps and peak qps) — this drives GPU sizing and buffer pool.
3) GPU preference — you mentioned A100 40GB in the call; happy to model H100 too.
4) Budget target expressed as $/1M tokens (helpful for us to map backlog to reserved capacity).

Next steps (actions)
- Sofia / Ben: confirm the numbers above (tokens, qps, latency SLO, budget $/1M tokens).
- Redwood: we’ll produce a 2-option estimate: (A) cost-optimized (A100 baseline), (B) performance-optimized (H100). Estimate will show monthly reserved cost, expected throughput, and implied $/1M tokens at your volume.
- Schedule a 30–45 min sizing call w/ Rishi (SE) to validate model selection and qps sizing — propose Thu 3/25 or Fri 3/26.

Attachments: I will follow up with a short pricing estimate and a mutual action plan template once you confirm volumes.

Thanks — appreciate the clarity on the budget target you shared on the call (gave us a helpful anchor).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the numbers from our end so you can size the estimate: 

1) Monthly tokens (prompt + generation) — current internal estimate: 1.2B tokens/month typical, up to 1.8B in peak months.
2) Throughput: typical sustained ~120 qps; expected peak bursts up to ~380 qps (peaks last ~10–20 minutes).
3) Context lengths: ~95% <=512, ~5% 2–4k (longer traces for recall).
4) Latency SLO: P95 <= 250ms for user-facing flows; background/batch less strict.
5) Model: leaning toward an open LLaMA-family 70B quantized variant we’ve tested; our infra team prefers A100 40GB for cost predictability (we have internal benchmarks). We are open to H100 if it materially improves throughput/cost.
6) Budget: we’re targeting an economics target of roughly $900 / 1M tokens (this is the internal target across prompt+generation). Committed reserved spend we can consider in the $30k–$45k/month range initially.

Compliance: SOC 2 and data residency in us-west are required. We’ll need a copy of SOC 2 evidence / attestation during procurement.

Timeline: pilot in June, production July. 

Let us know if you want us to share sample traffic profile (per-minute qps over a week) — we can export that.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of ML Infrastructure | FinTechCorp
sofia@fintechcorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@fintechcorp.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@fintechcorp.com>

Date: 2026-03-22T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Thanks Sofia — this is super helpful. I ran your numbers by Rishi and Marcus and attached a short pricing estimate + MAP template for the pilot. See the attached PDF for two reference configurations (ballpark monthly costs and implied unit economics at 1.2B tokens):

Option A — A100 40GB (cost-optimized)
- Reserved pool: 2x A100-40GB (+1 buffer GPU for peak buffer)
- Estimated sustained throughput: ~250–320 qps for Llama-70B quantized (serving with batching & prefix caching)
- Implied unit cost @1.2B tokens: ~ $780 / 1M tokens

Option B — H100 80GB (performance-optimized)
- Reserved pool: 1x H100-80GB + 1x H100 as buffer (or 2x H100 for higher headroom)
- Estimated sustained throughput: ~420–520 qps depending on quantization and model path
- Implied unit cost @1.2B tokens: ~ $520 / 1M tokens

Notes / assumptions:
- Unit costs above include reserved GPU amortization + baseline infra (network, storage, control plane) but exclude potential professional services or data egress costs.
- Throughput estimates assume model is running with 4-bit quantization (GGUF) and Redwood’s continuous batching/KV cache.
- Peak bursts: we recommend a small buffer GPU (or autoscale policy with burst capacity) to handle 10–20m spikes to avoid head-of-line latency.
- Compliance: we’ll include SOC 2 attestation and can bind data residency to us-west for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Next steps:
1) Review attached Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_Estimate.pdf (I’ve included 2–3 sizing bands).
2) Confirm whether you want A100 baseline or if you’d prefer us to price solely on H100.
3) Provide sample traffic profile if you can (per-minute qps) — Rishi can validate buffer sizing.
4) Let’s book the sizing call: Thu 3/25 10:00–10:45 PT (Rishi + Marcus + pricing). I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_Estimate.pdf, MAP_template.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
